```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, warning = F)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(dtwclust)
rm(list=ls(all=T))
```

This notebook reads the SHCS database export and derives, for every participant with a CHIP trajectory: sex,
ethnicity, smoking, injection drug use, the CD4 nadir, coinfections, the ART start and the durations of the drugs, the
time diagnosed but untreated, the set-point viral load, the viral load before and on ART, the age and year at the first
and last sequenced sample, the duration of diagnosed HIV infection at the first sample, and the time with detectable
HIV RNA. It writes `resources/SHCS_Metadata_univ.txt`, which is used by Table 1 and Tables S7 and S8.

# Load data

```{r}
# the participants with a CHIP trajectory and all their sequenced timepoints (02_SHCS_CHIP_trajectories.Rmd): the
# trajectory table has one row per trajectory and timepoint, including the timepoints at which the variant was not
# detected, so the first and the last sample of a person are the first and the last sequenced sample
traj_calls <- read.table("resources/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
trajectories <- traj_calls %>%
  select(ID, traj_id) %>% distinct()
sample_dates <- traj_calls %>% select(ID, LABDATE) %>% distinct()

pat <- read.csv("resources/SHCS_database/2025-09/pat.csv") %>% filter(ID %in% trajectories$ID)
pat <- pat %>% select(ID, BORN, SEX, ETHNICITY, IVD, RISK, CV_SMOKED, HIV_POSDATE, HIV_POSDOCDATE, REGDATE) %>%
  mutate(SEX=ifelse(SEX==1,1,0),
         ETHNICITY=ifelse(ETHNICITY==1,1,0),
       HIV_POSDATE=ifelse(HIV_POSDATE==""|is.na(HIV_POSDATE), HIV_POSDOCDATE, HIV_POSDATE),
       HIV_POSDATE=ifelse(HIV_POSDATE==""|is.na(HIV_POSDATE), REGDATE, HIV_POSDATE)) %>%
  select(-HIV_POSDOCDATE, -REGDATE)

summary(pat)
```


```{r}
lab <- read.csv("resources/SHCS_database/2025-09/lab.csv") %>% filter(ID %in% trajectories$ID)

cd4_nadir <- lab %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(CD4_nadir=min(CD4, na.rm = T)) %>%
  mutate(CD4_nadir_less200=ifelse(CD4_nadir<200,1,0))

cd4_nadir %>% summary


coinf <- lab %>%
  select(ID, TBC, TBI, AGHBS, ANTIHBS, ANTIHBC, AGHBE, ANTIHBE, ANTIHDV, HBVDNA_QUAL, SYPH_Q, VDRL_Q,CMV,TOXO,ANTIHCV,HCV_RNA_QUAL) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise_all(function(x) sum(x=="P", na.rm = T)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(TB=ifelse(sum(TBC, TBI)>0,1,0),
         HBV=ifelse(sum(ANTIHBC)>0,1,0),
         SYPH=ifelse(sum(SYPH_Q, VDRL_Q)>0,1,0),
         CMV=ifelse(sum(CMV)>0,1,0),
         TOXO=ifelse(sum(TOXO)>0,1,0),
         HCV=ifelse(sum(ANTIHCV,HCV_RNA_QUAL)>0,1,0)) %>%
  select(ID, TB, HBV, HCV, SYPH,CMV, TOXO)

coinf %>%   summary()
```

```{r}
med_drug <- read.csv("resources/SHCS_database/2025-09/med_drug.csv") %>% filter(ID %in% trajectories$ID)
med_drug_code <- read.csv("resources/SHCS_database/2025-09/med_drug_code.csv")
med_drug_art <- med_drug %>%
  filter(INDICATION == "A")

drugs <- med_drug_art %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse((as.Date(STOPDATE) - as.Date("2025-09-01")) >0, LABDATE, STOPDATE)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse(STOPDATE=="", as.Date("2025-09-01"), STOPDATE)) %>%
  mutate(min_STARTDATE=min(as.Date(STARTDATE)),
         START_before_2000=ifelse(year(as.Date(min_STARTDATE))<=2000, 1,0),
         STARTED_ART=ifelse((min_STARTDATE - as.Date("2025-09-01")) < -180, 1, 0)) %>%
  select(ID, START_before_2000, STARTED_ART) %>% distinct()


drugs %>% summary
```


```{r}
drugs_dur <- med_drug_art %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse(STOPDATE=="", "2025-09-01", STOPDATE)) %>%
  mutate(Duration_days=as.numeric(as.Date(STOPDATE)-as.Date(STARTDATE))) %>%
  select(ID, DRUG, Duration_days) %>%
  group_by(ID, DRUG) %>%
  mutate(Duration_days=sum(Duration_days)) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = DRUG, values_from = Duration_days, id_cols = ID) %>%
   replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~ as.integer(.x > 0),
    .names = "{.col}_bin"
  ))


drugs_cat_dur <- med_drug_art %>%
  merge(med_drug_code, by.x="DRUG", by.y="DRUG_CODE") %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse(STOPDATE=="", "2025-09-01", STOPDATE)) %>%
  mutate(Duration_days=as.numeric(as.Date(STOPDATE)-as.Date(STARTDATE))) %>%
  select(ID, CATEGORY_ID, Duration_days) %>%
  group_by(ID, CATEGORY_ID) %>%
  mutate(Duration_days=sum(Duration_days)) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CATEGORY_ID, values_from = Duration_days, id_cols = ID) %>%
   replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~ as.integer(.x > 0),
    .names = "{.col}_bin"
  ))
```


```{r}
noART_dur <- med_drug_art %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse((as.Date(STOPDATE) - as.Date("2025-09-01")) >0, LABDATE, STOPDATE)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse(STOPDATE=="", as.Date("2025-09-01"), STOPDATE)) %>%
  mutate(min_STARTDATE=min(as.Date(STARTDATE))) %>%
  select(ID, min_STARTDATE) %>% distinct() %>%
  merge(pat %>% select(ID, HIV_POSDATE), by="ID") %>%
  mutate(without_ART_days=as.numeric(as.Date(min_STARTDATE)-as.Date(HIV_POSDATE))) %>%
  mutate(without_ART_days=ifelse(without_ART_days<0,0,without_ART_days)) %>%
  select(ID, without_ART_days)

hist(log10(noART_dur$without_ART_days+1))
```



```{r}
spVL1 <- read.table("resources/spVL/spVL_calc.txt", header=F, sep="\t")
colnames(spVL1) <- c("ID", "spVL1")

sp_VL2 <- read.table("resources/spVL/spVL_all_patients.txt", header=F, sep=" ") %>% select(-V2)
colnames(sp_VL2) <- c("ID", "spVL2")

sp_VL <- merge(spVL1, sp_VL2, by="ID", all = T) %>%
   mutate(spVL1=ifelse(is.na(spVL1), spVL2, spVL1),
         spVL2=ifelse(is.na(spVL2), spVL1, spVL2)) %>%
filter(!(is.na(spVL1))) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(spVL=mean(c(spVL1, spVL2))) %>%
  filter(ID %in% trajectories$ID) %>%
  select(ID, spVL)
```


```{r}
rna <- med_drug_art %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse((as.Date(STOPDATE) - as.Date("2025-09-01")) >0, LABDATE, STOPDATE)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(STOPDATE=ifelse(STOPDATE=="", as.Date("2025-09-01"), STOPDATE)) %>%
  mutate(min_STARTDATE=min(as.Date(STARTDATE))) %>%
  select(ID, min_STARTDATE) %>% distinct() %>%
  merge(lab %>%
          select(ID, LABDATE, RNA)) %>%
  mutate(RNA_before_ART=ifelse(as.Date(LABDATE)-as.Date(min_STARTDATE) < 60, 1, 0))

rna_before <- rna %>%
  filter(RNA_before_ART == 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RNA)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(mean_preART_RNA=mean(RNA, na.rm=T),
            median_preART_RNA=median(RNA, na.rm=T),
            max_preART_RNA=max(RNA, na.rm=T))

rna_after <- rna %>%
  filter(RNA_before_ART == 0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RNA)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(max_RNA_ART=max(RNA),
            mean_RNA_ART=mean(RNA),
            median_RNA_ART=median(RNA))


```



```{r}
covar <- trajectories %>%
  merge(pat, all=T) %>%
  merge(cd4_nadir, all = T) %>%
  merge(coinf, all=T) %>%
  merge(drugs, all=T) %>%
  merge(drugs_dur, all=T) %>%
  merge(drugs_cat_dur, all=T) %>%
  merge(noART_dur, all=T) %>%
  merge(sp_VL, all=T) %>%
  merge(rna_before, all = T) %>%
  merge(rna_after, all = T)
```


```{r}

age <- sample_dates %>%
  merge(pat %>% select(ID, BORN)) %>%
  mutate(Age=year(as.Date(LABDATE))-BORN) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(min_Age=min(Age),
            max_Age=max(Age),
            first_Year=year(min(LABDATE)),
            last_Year=year(max(LABDATE))) %>%
  mutate(FollowUp_Time=max_Age-min_Age)



rna_Mean <- sample_dates %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(min_LABDATE=min(as.Date(LABDATE)),
            max_LABDATE=max(as.Date(LABDATE))) %>%
  merge(rna %>%
  rename(RNA_LABDATE=LABDATE)) %>%
  filter(as.Date(RNA_LABDATE)>=min_LABDATE & as.Date(RNA_LABDATE)<=max_LABDATE) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(mean_RNA_VL=mean(RNA, na.rm=T),
            median_RNA_VL=median(RNA, na.rm=T))


hiv_dur <- sample_dates %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(min_LABDATE=min(as.Date(LABDATE)),
            max_LABDATE=max(as.Date(LABDATE))) %>%
  merge(pat) %>%
 mutate(HIV_dur=round(as.numeric(min_LABDATE-as.Date(HIV_POSDATE))/365.25, digits = 2)) %>%
  select(ID, HIV_dur)
  
  

```


Time with detectable HIV RNA: the sum of the intervals between consecutive RNA measurements that end with a detectable
measurement (RNA > 0), so that every interval is counted once.

```{r}
time_detect_rna <- rna %>%
  filter(!is.na(RNA)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  arrange(ID, as.Date(LABDATE)) %>%
  mutate(deltaTime=c(0, diff(as.Date(LABDATE)))) %>%
  mutate(cumTime=ifelse(RNA>0, deltaTime, 0)) %>%
  summarize(TimeDetectRNA=round(sum(cumTime, na.rm = T)/365.25,digits = 2))
```




```{r}
covar <- covar %>%
  select(-traj_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  merge(age, by="ID") %>%
  merge(rna_Mean, by="ID") %>%
  merge(time_detect_rna, by="ID") %>%
  merge(hiv_dur, by="ID")
```


```{r}
write.table(covar, "resources/SHCS_Metadata_univ.txt", quote = F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
```

# Epidemiological description

```{r}
covar <- read.table("resources/SHCS_Metadata_univ.txt", sep="\t", header = T)
```



```{r}
apply(covar %>% select(min_Age, max_Age, FollowUp_Time, HIV_dur, median_RNA_VL, CD4_nadir), MARGIN = 2, median, na.rm=T)
apply(covar %>% select(min_Age, max_Age, FollowUp_Time, HIV_dur, median_RNA_VL, CD4_nadir), MARGIN = 2, quantile, na.rm=T, probs=c(0.25, 0.75))
apply(covar%>%select(ETHNICITY, SEX, IVD,RISK,CV_SMOKED,CD4_nadir_less200), MARGIN = 2, table)
apply(covar%>%select(ETHNICITY, SEX, IVD,RISK,CV_SMOKED,CD4_nadir_less200), MARGIN = 2, mean, na.rm=T)
```


```{r}
boxplot(covar$CD4_nadir)
boxplot(log10(covar$mean_RNA_VL+1))
boxplot(covar$HIV_dur)
```
